description: This file defines a pipeline behavior for request validation using FluentValidation within a MediatR-based CQRS pattern. It enforces validation rules on requests before they are processed by subsequent handlers.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that performs validation on each request using a set of validators before passing the request to the next handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Performs validation on the incoming request; if validation fails, throws an exception; otherwise, proceeds to the next delegate in the pipeline.
